name: Tower Of Babel
overview: The Tower of Babel narrative reveals humanity's unified language and purpose following God's command to multiply and fill the earth (Genesis 9:1; 11:1). Despite this divine directive, people gathered in the land of Shinar, building a city and a tower with bricks instead of stone, seeking to make a name for themselves rather than obey God's mandate (Genesis 10:10; 11:3). This account highlights the origins of diverse languages and nations, underscoring humanity's rebellion against God's plan and the resulting scattering across the earth (Genesis 10:5).
